key_insight: Multifidelity Operator Inference supplements scarce high-fidelity training data with abundant coarse-model data to reduce variance in learned reduced-order models.
engineering_relevance: More accurate non-intrusive surrogates can make repeated PDE evaluations more affordable for uncertainty quantification and engineering design optimization.
method: Collect scarce high-fidelity snapshots and abundant snapshots from coarser discretizations.
Fit reduced operators from state and time-derivative data using multifidelity linear regression.
Use the learned reduced model for inexpensive solution prediction.
evidence_signal: Experiments on model PDE problems show more accurate solution-field predictions than high-fidelity-only Operator Inference at the same computational budget.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish how performance changes when coarse discretizations poorly capture high-fidelity dynamics.
paper_title: Multifidelity Operator Inference for Non-intrusive Model Reduction under Data Scarcity
